✨ LAN-Orangutan | Go
🎯 Primary Use Case: Network discovery and device management for homelab environments.
✨ Key Features: • Auto-discover devices using nmap • Password protected • Label, group, and add notes to devices • Multi-network support • Tailscale integration
📖 Summary: LAN Orangutan is a self-hosted network discovery tool for homelab users. It allows users to scan their networks, identify devices, and manage them with persistent labeling and notes through a web dashboard or CLI. It also features integration with Tailscale for managing VPN peers.
